mechanism: Darunavir (protease inhibitor) may reduce vitamin D synthesis and increase vitamin D metabolism through CYP3A4 induction, potentially lowering vitamin D levels and increasing osteoporosis/bone disease risk in HIV patients.
action: Monitor vitamin D levels periodically in patients on darunavir; consider vitamin D supplementation or increased dietary intake; assess bone health status, particularly in patients with additional osteoporosis risk factors.
